## Fixes

- **Windows ruby layout crashes.** Ruby layout now writes only changed properties and compares dimensions at XAML's native float precision. This prevents repeated layout invalidation and `Layout cycle detected` errors when showing annotated text, changing its size or toggling readings.
- **Windows word-timed highlight crashes.** Negative leading glyph coordinates are preserved as clip offsets instead of being passed as negative Composition sizes. Static clips and animation keyframes use the same coordinate conversion.
- Ruby, word-by-word highlighting, font-size animations and wrapping remain enabled. Windows users should update the CLI and framework dependencies together, then rebuild their applications.

## Verification

Both native errors were reproduced on a physical Windows 11 PC. The fixed runtime completed 30 view open/close cycles, 20 ruby toggles, Japanese and Chinese word-timed text, empty text-timing paths and window resizing in one process running for more than 11 minutes without a new crash.

Two regressions execute the production C++ logic: the old implementations fail on non-converging layout and negative clipping sizes, while the fixes pass. Before this version-only release, workspace tests, Clippy, compilation and formatting checks passed for the same runtime source. Windows 10 and applications on other platforms were not run for these fixes.

## Install

```sh
cargo binstall bern-cli@0.1.14
```

Applications pin the same version: `bern = "=0.1.14"`.

---

## 修正

- **Windows 注音布局崩溃。** 仅写入发生变化的布局属性，并按 XAML 原生 float 精度比较尺寸，避免显示注音、改变字号或切换注音时反复触发布局，最终报出 `Layout cycle detected`。
- **Windows 逐字高亮崩溃。** 将合法的字形前缘负坐标保留为裁剪偏移，不再把它作为 Composition 的负尺寸；静态裁剪和动画关键帧使用同一坐标转换。
- 注音、逐字高亮、字号动画和换行均保留。建议 Windows 用户同步升级 CLI 与框架依赖，然后重新构建应用。

## 验证

两个原生错误均已在 Windows 11 物理机复现。修复后同一进程运行超过 11 分钟，完成 30 次打开/关闭视图、20 次注音切换，覆盖日语及中文逐字文本、空时间轴和窗口缩放，无新崩溃。

两项回归直接执行生产 C++ 逻辑：原实现分别因布局不收敛和负裁剪尺寸失败，修复后通过。此次仅调整版本与发行说明；同一运行时源码已通过工作区测试、Clippy、编译和格式检查。本次修复未在 Windows 10 或其他平台应用上运行验证。

## 安装

```sh
cargo binstall bern-cli@0.1.14
```

应用固定同一版本：`bern = "=0.1.14"`。
